description: Blocking release-readiness policy for the ft-xbnl0 finish line. The evaluator in scripts/check_ft_xbnl0_4_6_release_gates.sh consumes this file to turn leak evidence, permanent guards, soak confidence, and runtime performance budgets into stable go/no-go checks.

gate_map.name: Leak behavior
gate_map.failure_action: Run the ft-xbnl0.4.4 leak-oracle harness and save a passing summary bundle.

gate_map.name: Permanent guard surface
gate_map.failure_action: Repair the permanent finish-line guards before trusting release-readiness.

gate_map.name: Soak confidence
gate_map.source: latest swarm soak wrapper summary.json under artifact_roots.soak_matrix_root
gate_map.failure_action: Regenerate the smoke/release soak matrix until the wrapper summary passes and nested summaries agree.

gate_map.name: Performance budget
gate_map.source: nested smoke/release summaries referenced by the latest soak wrapper summary
gate_map.failure_action: Reduce runtime cost or tune the workload until RSS, duration, and backpressure budgets hold.
